hooks.name: ussd-property-on-save
hooks.description: Runs the USSD output-shape property test (testing.md property 6). ussd-engine adds the test and removes --passWithNoTests.

action.command: node scripts/hooks/saved-file.mjs --file "{{filePath}}" run "npx vitest run src/ussd --testNamePattern \"R.*USSD property\" --passWithNoTests"
